title: Does the Closed-Form Latency Mechanism Survive CUDA-Graph Capture?
summary_zh: 對 vLLM decode 延遲機制模型 host 項的一項可證偽、預先登錄的檢驗。CUDA-Graph capture 移除 decode step 的 26.7% / 34.2% / 46.0%（A100-40 / H100 / H200），且隨 HBM 頻寬單調。但被移除的成本並非模型所建模的隨 batch 增長之 scheduler 殘差——它大致隨 batch 維持常數且與該殘差反相關（斜率 −0.43，R²=0.17），kill-switch 觸發。預測器在此區間高估 eager step 約 22%。Llama-3.1-8B；RTX 5090 僅供測試。
summary_en: A falsifiable, pre-registered test of the host term in a vLLM decode-latency mechanism model. CUDA-Graph capture removes 26.7% / 34.2% / 46.0% of the decode step (A100-40 / H100 / H200), monotone in HBM bandwidth. But the removed cost is not the model's batch-growing scheduler residual — it is roughly batch-constant and anti-correlates with that residual (slope −0.43, R²=0.17), so the kill-switch fired. The predictor over-predicts the eager step about 22% in this regime. Llama-3.1-8B; RTX 5090 is test-only.
